kind: development feedback from focused runs, not release evidence
method: each module mutated alone (`mutmut run research.<module>.*`) with the test selection narrowed by PYTEST_ADDOPTS=-k to that module's own test file, so tests of other files could only kill more; stats re-collected per run; the module's .meta cache removed first; killed share counts only `killed` (suspicious and timeout are not counted as kills)
remeasured_experimental_views: after the study, bibliography, job-record and time-series builders were added
tool: mutmut 3.8.0 in the conda environment etl-benchmark (python 3.11.17)
